$comment: Allowlist for the band alignment test (src/lib/kb/bands.test.ts). Count thresholds must sit exactly on a band boundary. Monetary thresholds are in USD while revenue bands are in EUR, so a band may straddle a threshold at the rate in fx.json. Every such straddle must be listed here; the test fails if the computed set differs (e.g. after an fx.json or threshold update). A straddling answer makes the wizard ask a yes/no follow-up ('Is annual revenue above US$X?'); if that stays unanswered the engine reports the affected obligations as assumed.

straddles.note: USD 26,625,000 is roughly EUR 23.7M at the 2026-10-02 ECB rate, inside the EUR 10-25M band.

textOnlyTiers.note: The first cybersecurity audit report's due date depends on revenue tiers of USD 50M and 100M. These set a deadline, not applicability, so they are described in the obligation text and are not rule thresholds.
